english.title: Flew within an aerodrome traffic zone without maintaining a continuous watch on the appropriate radio frequency
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was the commander of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), flying within an aerodrome traffic control zone and failed to cause a continuous watch to be maintained on the appropriate radio frequency notified for communications at that aerodrome
english.legislation: Contrary to Rule 11(6)(a) of Schedule 1 to the Rules of the Air Regulations 2015 and Articles 249(2), 265(6) to, and part 2 of Schedule 13 of, the Air Navigation Order 2016.
